reason: I buy lighting from Wayfair, Amazon and Lowe's because I know how delivery and returns work. I've never heard of Nora Furnish, and $360 for a pendant from an unknown brand is a lot when I can get something similar from a store I trust.
objection: Unknown brand at $360, with 10 to 12 business days for delivery and a return policy where I pay shipping if I change my mind. If a fixture shows up wrong in one of my rentals, I'm stuck.
would_change_my_mind: Free returns, plus real reviews from other hosts or trade buyers, or a trade price when I buy several fixtures for my units.
